method: Godot get_omni_attenuation: max(1-(d/r)^4,0)^2 * max(d,0.0001)^(-decay); energy * linear RGB luminance * incidence cosine, native nonphysical units. Fixed 5x3 floor/ceiling and 5x3 on all four walls, 90 samples. Renderer PI scale common to both sides omitted. Receiver masks included; all production lights shadowless. Closed lift and ladder-landing grids include their adjacent connector spill, using the owning connector receiver mask.
